title: The NASH | 8BR • Hot Tub • Rooftops • Sleeps 24
description:
Experience Music City in luxury at THE NASH — two side-by-side designer homes with 8 bedrooms, 7 bathrooms, and room for 24. Enjoy rooftop patios, a hot tub, indoor shuffleboard, bold interiors, and an unbeatable location just over a mile to Broadway, 12 South, and The Gulch.

The space
Home 1:
Bedroom 1: King bed, standalone tub, walk-in shower
Bedroom 2: King bed, combo tub/shower
Bedroom 3: King bed, combo tub/shower
Bedroom 4: Custom bunk room with 1 bunk bed + twin trundle

Home 2:
Bedroom 1: King bed, standalone tub, walk-in shower
Bedroom 2: King bed, combo tub/shower
Bedroom 3: King bed, combo tub/shower
Bedroom 4: Custom bunk room with 1 bunk bed + twin trundle

📝 Things to Note:
- Starter kit provided: paper towels, toilet paper, linens, towels, dish soap, laundry pods, etc.
- Bathrooms stocked with full-sized premium shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap
- High-speed Wi-Fi for streaming and remote work
- Smart locks on front and back doors for easy, secure access
- Full-size washer and dryer in each home
- Shared parking in back + ample street parking
- Snacks and Champagne on us! 

📍 Location Perks:
- Quick Uber to Hattie B’s, The Gulch, Broadway, and Music Row
- Close to Midtown’s best bars, brunch spots, and boutiques
- Easy access to Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, and the Grand Ole Opry
- Local favorites nearby: Biscuit Love, Barista Parlor, and Five Daughters Bakery

Guest access
It's all yours! Guests have access to the entire home during your stay.

Other things to note
- Minimum age to rent the home is 23.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn’t happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.
- Apologies no furry friends at this home
- Street parking in front of home & shared parking behind
